notes: Reaction paths now reach their minima and say so when they do not: an IRC could stop tens of kcal/mol above both basins while Analyze read an activation energy off those endpoints (two to three and a half times too small on a test reaction). Paths no longer wander uphill, reach further by default, and carry their geometries. NEB runs report whether the band actually relaxed and adapt their own step size — a band that used to oscillate forever at the default now converges — and unrelaxed paths label barriers as lower bounds instead of printing a number. NMR shifts name their referencing assumption and accept a reference you computed yourself. The phase-estimation family (QCELS, RPE, QMEGS, BPE, BPDE, QKD) states that it is not a variational bound, and a Bayesian phase-difference gap is no longer presented as an S0-S1 excitation. Also: eigenvalue spectra are drawn as spectra, frozen-core and all-electron legs cannot be silently mixed in a CBS extrapolation, and a run with no basis specified records the default it used. Engine 0.1.3. Universal, signed and notarized macOS build. See the changelog: https://qemica-lab.com/changelog/
